title: Otherpack container (clutpack_ys, fontpack_fs/it, mrppack_ys, tex2pack_ys, texpack_ys)

container.notes: Little-endian. At 0x00 a list of u32 absolute file offsets, one per section, terminated by 0xFFFFFFFF (no count field, no end-of-data offset). The header is then filled with 0xFF bytes up to a 16-byte boundary. Each section is followed by zero padding to 16. Section i spans [offset[i], offset[i+1]); the last one runs to end of file. Section kind by first 4 bytes: CLT2 = colour table, MRP + state byte (0 on disk) = menu resource pack, TIM2 = texture, else opaque. Expected section counts: clutpack_ys 4, fontpack_fs 7, fontpack_it 6, mrppack_ys 23, tex2pack_ys 11, texpack_ys 5.

records.name: sectionOffset
records.where: file offset 0; entry i at 4*i; stop at the first value equal to 0xFFFFFFFF
records.count: number of dwords before the 0xFFFFFFFF terminator (see enum OtherpackSectionCount)

fields.name: offset
fields.notes: Absolute file offset of section i, multiple of 16. Empty section = same value as the next section's offset. Recompute all later rows if a section changes size.

records.name: terminator
records.where: file offset 4*N, immediately after the last sectionOffset

fields.name: endMarker
fields.notes: Always 0xFFFFFFFF (4294967295). Followed by 0xFF fill bytes up to the next 16-byte boundary.

records.name: sectionMagic
records.where: first 4 bytes of each section (file offset = sectionOffset[i]); informational, used to choose a sub-format

fields.name: magic
fields.notes: Read as little-endian u32. For MRP only the low 3 bytes ('MRP') are the magic; byte 3 is a load state (0 on disk, 1 in memory).

roundTrip: Keep the number of sections (offsets before 0xFFFFFFFF) unchanged.
Header fill after the terminator uses 0xFF bytes; padding after each section uses 0x00 bytes.
Lay out sections in index order: record start, append bytes, zero-pad to a multiple of 16.
Copy unedited sections byte-for-byte; the last section's bytes include the padding up to end of file.
Empty sections keep the same offset as the following section.
MRP sections written to disk keep state byte 3 = 0.
gaps: Contents of fontpack_fs / fontpack_it sections and meaning of the fs / it suffixes.
VBF folder of these packs and whether language-specific copies exist.
Not verified that every vanilla otherpack ends on a 16-byte boundary.
texpack_ys assumed to hold TIM2 sections only (by name).
